name: CrackMaster License API
note: Replace base_url / path if your hosting folder is different. All responses are JSON.

license.description: App login / license verification. Call this every time the app starts (and whenever you want to re-check).

user_key.info: License key typed by the user

serial.info: Unique device id (HWID) of the phone

game.info: Which game this app is for. If sent, a key of the other game is rejected. Strongly recommended.

error_reasons: License Key and Hardware ID are required!
This license key has been banned!
This key is for Pubg, not FreeFire!
This license key is temporarily paused!
Device limit reached! Max N device(s) allowed for this key.
rules: App must treat status=true as logged in, anything else as failed and show 'reason'.
Expiry clock starts at the FIRST successful login (expired_date is then fixed).
A key is locked to the device(s) of its first login. Max devices is set per key (0 = unlimited).
token = md5(user_key . serial) (lowercase hex). The app may re-compute it to validate the response.
Time format of expired_date: Y-m-d H:i:s, timezone Asia/Dhaka (UTC+6).

reset_device.description: Remove the device lock of a key so it can be used on a new phone. No API key needed. Daily limit per key is set by the admin.

key_info.description: Read the state of a key (optional, for showing expiry / reset info in the app).

feedback.note: There is no feedback endpoint on the server yet. Tell us what the app needs (fields to send, where to store/notify) and it can be added.

auth_methods.license_login: none (the license key itself is the credential)
auth_methods.balance: reseller API key in header X-API-Key (only for reseller tools, not needed by the app)
